book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn MARK

content: Karasaras en Sounkamwarak

Kedekedeo, Sises pil ketin tapihada padahk ni oaroahr en Lehen Kalili. Pwehki lapalahn pokon ehu me pokonpene reh, ih eri ketidahng pohn kisin pwoht kis oh ketidiong powe. Pwohto peipei nan leho, a pokono mi ni oaroahro.
E ahpw ketin padahkihong irail soahng tohto ni karasaras, duwen eh kin ketin epwehnki wia nan sapwellime padahk. E ahpw mahsanihong irail,
“Kumwail rong. Aramas emen mie me kohieilahng kamwarak.
Eri, ni eh kamwakamwarak werentuhke kan, ekei mwerediong nan kisinial en mwahto, menpihr kei ahpw pihrdo kangasang.
A ekei mwerediong nan mweli, wasa me pwehl pedeped. Re wosada mwadang, pwehki pwehlo eh sohte loal.
Ni karakar en ketipin eh lel irail, re mwoatoredi; oh pwehki kalewarail kan sohte lel wasa loal, re mwadang mengila.
A ekei mwerediong nanpwungen dihpw tekatek kei; ni dihpw tekatek ko ar keirda, re kasokehla kisin tuhke ko; iei me re sohte wahki.
A ekei mwerediong nan pwehl mwahu; re ahpw wosada, keirda, oh wa mwahu; ekei wa silihsek, a ekei weneisek, a ekei epwiki.”
Sises ahpw pil mahsanih, “Eri, kumwail rong, ma mie salengamwail mehn rong wasa.”
Kahrepen Karasaras kan
Eri, ni Sises eh ketin kalapwukala, me ehk riemeno oh ekei me iang rong ahpw patohdo reh pwe re en peki en ketin kawehwehiong irail karasaras akan.
Ih eri ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Ong kumwail me e mweimweiong ese manaman rir kan duwen Wehin Koht. A ong irail kan me mihmi liki, re pahn ese soahng koaros sang ni karasaras.
Pwe,

content.text: pwe re en dehr wekidekiong Koht

content: Sises ketin Kawehwehda Karasaras en Sounkamwarako
Sises eri ketin keinemwe rehrail, mahsanih, “Kumwail sohte wehwehki karasaras pwoatet? A ia duwen amwail pahn dehdehki karasaras teikan? Eri, iet duwe:
sounkamwarako, iei me kin kamwarak mahsen en Koht.
Ekei aramas rasehng werentuhke ko me mwerediong nan kisinial. Ni ar kin rong mahseno, Sehdan ahpw kin kohdo oh kauwehsang irail.
Ekei aramas kin rasehng kisin werentuhke me mwerediong nan wasa takain. Ni ar kin rong mahseno, re kin perenkihda oh ale.
Ahpw e sohte kin tengala rehrail, oh sohte kin werei. Pwe ni apwal oh kamakam eh kin lelohng irail pwehki mahseno, re kin mwadang lohdi.
Ekei aramas kin rasehng kisin werentuhke ko me mwerediong nanpwungen dihpw tekatek. Iei irail me kin rong mahseno,
a pwehki pwunod en mouren sampah kan, noahrok en dipwisou kan, oh soangen ineng teikan me kin pwarada oh kasokehla mahseno, me kahrehda e sohte kin wa.
Ekei rasehng kisin war me mwerediong nan pwehl mwahu. Re kin rong mahseno, ale, ahpw kin wa: ekei wa silihsek, ekei weneisek, a ekei wa epwiki.”
Lamp pahn Kohpwa
Sises ahpw pil ketin usehla sapwellime mahsen ong irail, “Mie rehmwail me kin isikada nah lamp oh kihdiong pahn kohpwa de pahn peht? E soh pahn kidahng nan uhdahn dewe?
Sohte me rir kot mie, me sohte pahn kasansalda; pil sohte me ekiek kot mie, me sohte pahn kalohkseli.
Kumwail eri rong, ma mie salengamwail mehn rong wasa!”
E ahpw pil mahsanihong irail, “Kumwail tehk mwahu me kumwail pahn ronget! Mehn sohngohte me kumwail pahn sohngki meteikan, ih me Koht pahn ketin sohngkin kumwail—oh pil laudsang mehlel.
Pwe aramas me ahneki mehkot, ekis pahn pil kohwong; a me sohte eh mehkot, e pahn pil pehdsang mehkis me mi reho.”
Karasaras en Kekeirdahn kisin Werentuhke
E pil mahsanihong irail, “Wehin Koht rasehng aramas emen me kamwarak kisin werentuhke kei nan sapwe.
Nindokon eh memeir nipwong oh pepehd ni rahn, kisin werentuhke ko kin wos oh kekeirda, ahpw e sohte kin wehwehki duwen mepwukat eh kin wiewiawi.
Pwe pwehlo me kin kawosehda kisin waro, kakairada, oh kihong wah: mahs e kin kisin dihpw tikitik, mwuhr, e kin wiahla kisin tuhke, a pil mwuri, e ahpw kin wa; a nan waho kin diren kisin war.
Ni wah kan ar kin mah, aramas ahpw kin lupukedi oh kihpene, pwe ahnsowo ih ahnsoun dolung.”
Karasaras en kisin Werentuhke Tikitik
E ahpw pil ketin mahsanih, “Dahme kitail pahn karasahiong Wehin Koht? De karasaras da kitail pahn doadoahngki pwe en kawehwehda?
Eri, e rasehng kisin werentuhke kis, me keieu tikitik nanpwungen werentuhke kan. A ni eh kin kamweremwerdiong nan pwehl,
e kin wosada oh keirda oh wiahla tuhke laud pwoat, laudsang tuhkehn nan mwetuwel kan koaros. E ahpw kin kasangpeseng, oh menpihr en pahnlahng kan kin pihrdo oh wia pasarail kan pahn mwetehn rah kan.”
Sises ketin kawehwehiong aramas akan mahsen en Koht ni soangen karasaras pwukat duwen me re kin kak wehwehki.

Sohte kapahrek ehu e kin ketin wiahiong aramas akan, me e sohte kin ketin doadoahngki karasaras; a ni eh kin ketin kalapwukala rehn sapwellime tohnpadahk ko, e kin ketin kawehwehiong irail karasaras koaros.
Sises ketin Kamwelehdi Melimel ehu nan Leho
Nin soutik en rahnohte Sises ketin mahsanihong sapwellime tohnpadahk ko, “Kitail douluhlla mahs palio leho.”
Ni arail kamwuralahr pokono, tohnpadahk ko ahpw karadahng pohn pwohto me Sises ketiket powe oh iang ketila; pil ekei pwoht iang irail tangatang kolahng palio.
Ahpw engmahda, oh iloak kan pwungupwungdahng pohn pwohto, kereniong kamwowihedi.
A Sises ketiket mwurin pwohto, seiseimwok oh tapwi mi pohn sapwellime uluhl. Tohnpadahk ko eri kaopehda, patohwanohng, “Maing Sounpadahk, komw sohte kupwurohki atail nektehn mehla?”
Sises eri ketin kipada oh angiangihada melimelo, mahsanih, “Tokedi!” E ahpw pil mahsanihong iloak kan, “Kumwail meleileidi!” Eri, ni ahnsowohte melimelo pa tokedi, ahpw meleileidi kowahlap.
E ahpw ketin mahsanihong irail, “Dahme kumwail masepwehngki? Dah, kumwail saikinte pwosonla?”
Re ahpw masepwehkada kowahlap oh ndindapene nanpwungarail, “Ihs memenet, me kisinieng oh iloak kan pil kin peikiong??”
